verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents running against your own infrastructure: it can launch a local browser (`localBrowser.launch`) or attach over CDP to any Chromium you already run, with local user-data directories, as an alternative to Browserbase cloud browsers. The pack never states that the product is open source or self-hostable as a whole, and caching is described as server-side, which suggests some features depend on a hosted service. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/open-source license documentation, confirmation that server-side features (caching, observability) can run self-hosted, independent hands-on corroboration of fully self-hosted deployment.
